archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Gears of War: E-Day early access begins

entries.headline: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles releases Colossal Update and two DLC packs
entries.summary: Developer Tomas Sala announces on Xbox Wire that the Colossal Update, Verne Bannerless DLC and Medieval Houses DLC are available on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and PC. The update brings the Xbox version in line with the PC development version and introduces upgradable surveyors, including the large Behemoth.

entries.headline: Gears of War: E-Day opens early access ahead of October 6 launch
entries.summary: Xbox Wire announces early access for Premium Edition owners and Game Pass subscribers with the Premium Upgrade. Early access began October 1 at 15:00 UTC; the full worldwide launch follows October 6 at the same time on Xbox Series X|S, Windows PC and Steam.

entries.summary: A Telltale interview on PlayStation Blog confirms an October 29 launch for The Wolf Among Us Remastered. Game director and VP of Creative Matt Saia discusses revisiting Fabletown and rebuilding the classic.

entries.headline: Kena: Scars of Kosmora moves from 2026 to 2027
entries.summary: Gematsu relays Sony Interactive Entertainment and Ember Lab’s announcement that Kena: Scars of Kosmora has moved from 2026 to 2027. The team wants additional time to polish its expanded experience. Physical and digital PS5 releases are planned, alongside PC versions on Steam and Epic Games Store.

entries.headline: Metro 2033 and Metro Last Light receive next-generation updates
entries.summary: IGN reports that 4A Games will update Metro 2033 and Metro Last Light on October 22 for PC and October 29 for consoles. PC gains DLSS support and quality-of-life improvements. PS5 and Xbox Series X versions offer native 4K at 60 fps or upscaled 4K at 120 fps. Full patch notes are still forthcoming.

entries.headline: PS5 adds QSSR AI upscaling, starting with Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei
entries.summary: PlayStation Blog announces Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), a PS5 AI-upscaling tier developed through Sony and AMD’s Project Amethyst collaboration. Marvel’s Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei receive QSSR graphics options through same-day patches. PSSR remains the PS5 Pro solution.

entries.headline: IKEA and Xbox launch nine-piece YXSTABY gaming furniture collection
entries.summary: Xbox Wire announces the worldwide October 1 launch of IKEA and Xbox’s jointly developed YXSTABY collection. Its nine pieces combine gaming, storage and everyday home use, including a lounge chair, monitor stand, TV stand on castors and a thumbstick-inspired stool developed from original Xbox controller 3D design files.

entries.headline: Elta: Defy All Gods opens free PS5 demo ahead of February 2027 release
entries.summary: Afterburner Studios introduces Elta: Defy All Gods on PlayStation Blog and announces a free PS5 demo. The game combines hand-to-hand martial arts, magic and nonlinear platform exploration, with three martial-art stances and dragon-companion abilities. The announced launch date is February 2, 2027.

entries.headline: Terraria+ and Kunio-kun’s Survivors of the Dead join Apple Arcade
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Terraria+ and くにおくんのサバイバーズ・オブ・ザ・デッド are available through Apple Arcade; Arc System Works released the latter on October 1. Subscribers can play on compatible Apple devices. The writer observed Japanese display in Terraria+ despite the store not listing Japanese; this observation is not an official language-support guarantee.

entries.headline: Doom: The Dark Ages - Revelations announces free Slaughter Mode update
entries.summary: IGN relays id Software’s Slayers Club Live announcement of a free Slaughter Mode update next month for Doom: The Dark Ages - Revelations. Players face escalating demon waves across multiple arenas, pursue personal round and score records, and earn cosmetics. No specific release date was announced.

entries.headline: IGN reviews Ghost of Yotei’s story expansion and Most Wanted mode
entries.summary: IGN’s DLC review says Echoes of Sekigahara and Most Wanted build on Ghost of Yotei’s combat and landscapes. The story expansion uses flashbacks to explore Atsu’s past, while Most Wanted includes Jin Sakai as a playable character with his original mechanics. These are the reviewer’s impressions, not a separate official launch announcement.

entries.headline: Invincible VS adds Angstrom Levy on October 13
entries.summary: Gematsu relays Skybound Games and Quarter Up’s announcement that Angstrom Levy arrives October 13 in Invincible VS Season 2, as its third DLC fighter and 21st playable character. His kit uses portals and orbs for setups, zoning and strategy. The report also confirms an advance playable appearance at Evo France.

entries.headline: AUTOMATON preview describes an ensemble approach for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
entries.summary: AUTOMATON’s first-episode preview describes Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 as an ensemble narrative with film influences, contrasting it with the earlier series. The report names CD PROJEKT RED and TRIGGER as producers and gives an October 20 Netflix release. Narrative judgments are the writer’s impressions.

entries.headline: Road to Vostok releases Build 2: Nomads with AI battles and new maps
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Antti Leinonen released the free Build 2: Nomads update, version 0.2.0.0, for the PC survival FPS Road to Vostok on October 1. It adds battles between AI, the friendly Nomads faction, maps, bosses and traders. Some planned tasks and shelter features are deferred for the coming weeks.

entries.headline: ARC Raiders reports an 85% reduction in pre-arranged solo teaming
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays Embark Studios’ October 1 statement about detecting players who coordinate before entering solo matches and preventing those groups from sharing matches. The studio says teaming participants fell 85% after five days and affected raids dropped from roughly one in 50 to one in 300. Spontaneous in-raid proximity-chat cooperation remains permitted.

entries.headline: KRAFTON ends development of PUBG: Black Budget
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that KRAFTON announced the cancellation of PUBG: Black Budget on October 1. The PvPvE extraction shooter underwent two closed alpha tests but did not reach release. The decision concerns Black Budget, not the entire PUBG franchise.
